summary: pykernel sandbox is opt-in: the zero isolation.Profile is ModeInsecureDisabled, so manager.New no longer fails on hosts without Landlock ABI 6 or CAP_SYS_PTRACE (Granite and ERP failed to start on 0.53.0). Hosts that want confinement set Sandbox: isolation.Profile{Mode: isolation.ModeRequired}. execute still requires a verified sandbox unless InsecureAllowUnconfinedRuntime is set. Breaking: the numeric values of isolation.Mode swapped.
